P.name: King's Tribute
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever a nearby enemy dies, '''Trundle''' {{tip|heal|heals}} himself for {{as|{{pp|key=%|1.8 + (5.5-1.8)/17*(x-1) for 20}} of their '''maximum''' health}}.

Q.name: Chomp
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Trundle''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 7 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|25 '''bonus''' range}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|slow}} the target by 75% for {{fd|0.1}} seconds.
Q.description2: After using the empowered attack, '''Trundle''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} for 5 seconds and reduces the target's {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}} by half that amount for the same duration.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Attack Damage|{{ap|20 to 40}}}}
{{st|Attack Damage Reduction|{{ap|20/2 to 40/2}}}}

W.name: Frozen Domain
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Trundle''' coats the target location in ice for 8 seconds. While he is within the area, he gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, and 25% increased {{tip|healing}} from all sources.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|30 to 110}}%}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|20 to 52}}%}}

E.name: Pillar of Ice
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Trundle''' erects a pillar of ice at the target location for 6 seconds, which {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} units hit up to 225 units from its center. The pillar acts as [[terrain]] and {{tip|slows}} nearby enemies.

R.name: Subjugate
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Trundle''' drains the life force out of the target enemy champion, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|heal|healing}} himself for the same amount. He also reduces 40% of their '''current''' {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}}, while gaining the same amount reduced as {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}, respectively, for himself. Additionally, he increases in {{tip|size}} by 18% while reducing the target's size by {{fd|9.9}}%.
R.leveling:
{{st|Total Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|20 to 30}}% {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health|health}}}}
{{st|Total Healing|{{as|{{ap|20 to 30}}% {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health|health}}}}
R.description2: Half of the drain's '''total''' damage, healing, and resistances reduction is applied on-cast, while the other half is applied every second over the next 4 seconds. The size modifiers last for 8 seconds and are applied over the first {{fd|2.25}} seconds of the duration, both increasing '''Trundle's''' size by 2% and reducing the target's size by {{fd|1.1}}% every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Initial Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|20/2 to 30/2}}% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health|health}}|Magic Damage Per Second|{{as|{{ap|20/8 to 30/8}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.25}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health|health}}}}
{{st|Initial Healing|{{as|{{ap|20/2 to 30/2}}% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health|health}}|Healing Per Second|{{as|{{ap|20/8 to 30/8}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.25}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health|health}}}}
R.description3: The resistances reduction on the target will linger for 4 seconds after the drain has ended.
